facts.fact: INTIC reports that on 30 June 2025 the SCDM Management Committee approved the State Root CA certificate, opening accreditation of second-level certification entities such as CEDSIF and Movitel, which are still preparing.
facts.system: SCDM (Sistema de Certificação Digital de Moçambique)

systems.system: Sistema de Certificação Digital de Moçambique (SCDM)
systems.tiers: State Root CA; second-level CAs in preparation

MOZ.note: The document mentions digital sovereignty only in general terms about the PKI, with no rule, hosting or contract term on state data.

facts.fact: INTIC says the digital certification work implements Law 3/2017 of 9 January, the Electronic Transactions Law.
INTIC says Decree 59/2019 of 3 July, the Regulation of the Digital Certification System, is the instrument made for the system under the Electronic Transactions Law.
